861:t_024:7.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「That's all for Mr. $$ゲイツ$$'s Life Lessons! See you next week!」

861:t_025:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥かなめ$$, can you hear me!? I came to bring you back!」

861:t_025:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll be honest, $$千鳥かなめ$$. I'm disappointed in you. I thought you were a far more impressive woman.」

861:t_025:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I never thought you were such a weakling that you'd quit the game over a single Game Over...」

861:t_025:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, what are you yelling about with a loudspeaker in the middle of the night!? I just have to resume, right? Resume it!」

861:t_025:7.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Wait, where are you going, $$宗介$$?」

861:t_025:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「Next is the player's place. Threats in the name of persuasion, to keep them playing for 36 hours...」

861:t_026:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Mmm... where are we~? Oh, $$相良$$!」

861:t_026:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain, have you also paused the game to take a break?」

861:t_026:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Who cares about the game~. More importantly, please call me $$テッサ$$ like the other day~」

861:t_026:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「C-C-C-Captain!? I'll call the medical officer right now, so please, hold yourself together!」

861:t_026:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「! N-no, that's not it! I didn't mean it like that, I was just half asleep...!」

861:t_026:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Please don't tell anyone else! I'm begging you! I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I'm so sorry~!」

861:t_027:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「A pause, huh... Good timing. Take a nice, long break.」

861:t_027:4.en:
$$アル$$
「The ideal opportunity has arrived to present the superb joke I promised last time, Sergeant.」

861:t_027:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Very well. I'm a man of my word. I promised, so I'll see it through!」

861:t_027:6.en:
$$アル$$
「Admirable resolve, Sergeant. Now then, everyone, please listen closely.」

861:t_027:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain, is the Aegis ship the target? Is that shipshape!?」

861:t_027:8.en:
$$アル$$
「...Sergeant, I think that is more of a pun than a joke...」

861:t_027:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「Shut up! Just end the game!」

861:t_028:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「A pause, huh... Good timing. Take a nice, long break.」

861:t_028:4.en:
$$アル$$
「The ideal opportunity has arrived to present the superb joke I promised last time, Sergeant.」

861:t_028:6.en:
$$アル$$
「With all that time, what a pathetic showing. You worthless pig, you're not even good for crap.」

861:t_028:8.en:
$$アル$$
「Hahaha, now this is a joke, Sergeant.」

861:t_028:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're an AI, so don't just laugh it off!」

861:t_029:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$宗介$$, say hello to all the players. For the record, this is an order.」

861:t_029:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「An order...? Why are you the one giving it?」

861:t_029:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Heh heh, because yours truly is a Master Sergeant!」

861:t_029:6.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Don't get cocky, $$ウェーバー$$.」

861:t_029:7.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's right, you only got the rank because we were short-staffed. And in the first place, you...」

861:t_029:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「T-the wind's starting to turn against me...! Hurry up and wrap it up, $$宗介$$!」

861:t_029:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「...so says our clunker of a Master Sergeant. Well then, see you again.」

861:t_029:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hey, hold on! Who's a clunk...」

861:t_030:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「I think there are two kinds of women in the world, but I also think people can be divided into two kinds.」

861:t_030:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Those who clear SRW, and those who don't... You're definitely the former.」

861:t_030:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's not sarcasm, either. I mean it as the highest praise.」

861:t_030:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's why I definitely want you to come back. To settle things with me, too.」

861:t_030:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「Well then, until we meet again...」

861:t_031:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're quitting here, huh... I thought you'd go a bit further, but I seem to have overestimated you.」

861:t_031:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「If my words angered you, come at me. With everything you've got.」

861:t_031:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「But even so, you can't stop my plan. The world will transform.」

861:t_031:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll see your struggles next time. Until that day, rest up.」

861:t_032:3.en:
$$バサラ$$
「All of you! Listen to my song!!」

861:t_033:3.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Players, thank you for your hard work. Before you take your break, hear my resolve.」

861:t_033:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「To prepare for the escalating battles, I searched for a way to surpass my limits... And after three days and nights of thinking without sleep, this is the result!」

861:t_033:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I'll put all my feelings into a song too!」

861:t_033:6.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Here I go, 'I Am $$ガムリン$$'! Ooooh! Listen to my song...!」

861:t_034:3.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Oh, $$ミレーヌ$$! If you have time, there's something I'd like you to listen to along with the players!」

861:t_034:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「To break out of my shell, I put my resolve into a song!」

861:t_034:7.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Then here I go! 'I Am $$ガムリン$$'! Listen to my song...!」

861:t_034:8.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Listen to my song! ...Just kidding~!」

861:t_035:3.en:
$$クラン$$
「Hm! What, are you already quitting!? You're as lacking in spirit as ever!」

861:t_035:4.en:
$$クラン$$
「...But overdoing it is certainly bad! Managing your health is part of a pilot's job!」

861:t_035:5.en:
$$クラン$$
「Can't be helped, I permit a break! But I will be resting alongside you!」

861:t_035:6.en:
$$クラン$$
「N-not that I want to be with you even a little or anything like that! It's a good chance, so I'll teach you what a soldier needs to know...」

861:t_035:7.en:
$$クラン$$
「Oh, enough! Just go on your break already! That's an order from a superior! Understood!?」

861:t_036:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Phew... today's battle was a rough one...」

861:t_036:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「I never noticed because someone's always around, but being alone is surprisingly lonely...」

861:t_036:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「But in the game, I have comrades. And of course, you, the player, are one of them.」

861:t_036:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「So I'll be waiting until we meet again. Flying with you in '3rd Super Robot Wars Z' is fun.」
